stats.title: Key Economic
stats.description: Congo possesses diversified economic potential. CDECO supports investors across all strategic sectors.

sectors.title: Strategic Investment Sectors
sectors.subtitle: Major growth and investment opportunities across all key sectors of the Congolese economy.
sectors.hydrocarburesDesc: The upstream oil and gas sector is the cornerstone of the economy, accounting for over 80% of exports and nearly 60% of fiscal revenues.
sectors.tourismeDesc: The government is actively developing premier ecotourism destinations, alongside historical and seaside tourism segments.
sectors.agricultureDesc: With over 10 million hectares of fertile arable lands and favorable rainfall, Congo offers outstanding agro-industrial opportunities.
sectors.minesDesc: The Congolese subsoil holds vast mineral reserves: iron ore, potash, phosphate, gold, diamonds, and rare metals under a transparent legal code.
sectors.foretsDesc: Second largest tropical rainforest on Earth after the Amazon, the Congo Basin is a pillar of global biodiversity and sustainable forestry.
sectors.infrastructureDesc: The Pointe-Noire deepwater port and multi-modal corridors position Congo as the maritime gateway to Central Africa.
sectors.educationDesc: Vocational training programs and academic excellence equip Congolese youth for leadership in a globalized world.
sectors.numeriqueDesc: An emerging regional tech hub backed by national optic fiber rollouts and innovative digital startups.
sectors.energieDesc: Immense hydroelectric and solar potential provides abundant opportunities for clean electrification and green industry.
sectors.autresDesc: Banking, insurance, telecommunications, and logistical services driving regional cross-border commerce.

mission.title: Three Pillars of Intervention
mission.description: CDECO deploys its initiatives across three complementary strategic pillars to maximize economic impact.
mission.p1Desc: Facilitating commercial ties between Congo and international partners through proactive economic diplomacy.
mission.p2Desc: Supporting Congolese small and medium enterprises in their sustainable growth and international expansion.
mission.p3Desc: Building robust bridges between local economic champions and global investors.

values.title: Founding Principles of CDECO
values.description: The values that guide every action and build enduring trust with our global partners.
values.v1Desc: CDECO operates with complete political, religious, and ideological independence to ensure utmost objectivity.
values.v2Desc: Integrity, transparency, and accountability guide every decision and commitment of our community.
values.v3Desc: CDECO champions balanced partnerships founded on reciprocity, mutual trust, and shared long-term interests.
values.v4Desc: A culture of rigor, efficiency, and quality structures every single initiative to meet international standards.
values.v5Desc: CDECO supports inclusive, responsible, and resilient growth serving both current and future generations.

whyInvest.title: Why Invest in Congo
whyInvest.description: A business-friendly environment at the heart of Central Africa.
whyInvest.r1Desc: A continuously improving economic environment backed by structural reforms to attract foreign direct investment.
whyInvest.r2Desc: At the heart of Central Africa, with privileged access to the Congo Basin and the 150M+ consumer CEMAC market.
whyInvest.r3Desc: Huge potential: oil & gas, mining, forests covering 70% of the land, and vast fertile arable soil.
whyInvest.r4Desc: Active transition toward agribusiness, digital innovation, clean energy, and local processing.
whyInvest.r5Desc: A young, educated workforce and a skilled diaspora ready to drive nation-building.
whyInvest.r6Desc: A trusted network of excellence to facilitate your investments, permits, and strategic partnerships.
